decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
1/ The proposed  single storey rear extension would, by reason of its  size, position and appearance  in relation to  neighbouring residential properties, be unduly obtrusive, detrimental to the amenities of adjoining occupiers  and is contrary to the Policies  ENVB 1.1 (New Development)   and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the  Unitary Development Plan, (2003) and Supplementary Planning Guidance, "Residential Extension Guidelines".     

2/  The proposed rear extension by virtue of its size, position and appearance would be out of character with the area,  that fails  to preserve or enhance the character of the adjoining Osterley Park Conservation Area, in conflict with the objectives of UDP Policy ENVB 1.1, (New Development) , ENVB 2.1, (Designation of Conservation Areas and Boundary Review of Existing Areas) and ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse house.
